name: Accurate single scattering under point light (Walter et al.)
aliases: Walter's Method for Accurate Single Scattering
definition: Computes single scattering effects in participating media under a point light source by treating the computation as a search problem to find all points on the surface that connect the point light and the camera sample via Fermat’s principle.
summary: Walter et al. computes single scattering under point lights by finding surface points connecting light and camera via Fermat's principle, a task impossible for volumetric path tracing.
